title: One platform, or many
sub: Platform and solution architecture, a series on the data platform and what is built on it: why one platform, with every domain owning its data on it, is the simplest choice for most organisations, what every extra platform brings with it, and when a second can't be helped.
howto: Technology green is a platform, and the rules each one brings with it are drawn as bands across it: who's who and who may see what, masks on private data, lineage, and a log of who did what. Blue is each domain's data products, and a gold tag is an owner in the business. Red is a barrier and its toll, on the river and between the platforms; amber, a lantern's colour, is the road every domain shares.
